summary: The diff implements changes to SpinWheelPage.tsx, backend/main.mo, and supporting files to remove the cooldown, restrict rewards to trophies and points, wire trophies to Total Score, and wire points to Virtual Pet. Most requirements appear addressed, but some acceptance criteria details are uncertain due to truncation. The implementation looks largely complete with a few verifiable gaps.

missing_requirements.requirement: No localStorage or state-based cooldown logic enforces a wait period between spins.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend still defines SPIN_COOLDOWN = 1200000000000 (20 minutes), which suggests cooldown logic may still exist in the backend spin handler even if the frontend no longer enforces it. The diff is truncated so the backend spin endpoint cannot be fully verified as cooldown-free.

missing_requirements.requirement: The Virtual Pet section displays the message 'Grow your pet by earning points from games and spin rewards!'
missing_requirements.reason: The SpinWheelPage.tsx is truncated and the exact message displayed after a points reward cannot be confirmed from the visible portion of the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: After a trophy win, the result message reads 'Keep playing and Spinning to earn more!'
missing_requirements.reason: The SpinWheelPage.tsx is truncated and the exact result message for trophy wins cannot be confirmed from the visible portion of the diff.

hallucinated_features.description: A migration module (backend/migration.mo) was added to handle schema migration adding a totalTrophies field to the Reward type.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asked to fix spin wheel behavior and wire rewards. A full data migration module was not requested and goes beyond what is necessary for the frontend reward wiring.

hallucinated_features.description: Spin history is persisted to localStorage using a spinHistory key.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention any requirement to track or display spin history. This is an extra feature not present in the requirements.
